result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source at release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056 defines NotificationMetaObject as a serde-transparent wrapper around MetaObject. MetaObject is an arbitrary JsonObject map and the NotificationMetaObject schema reserves io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId while explicitly permitting additionalProperties=true. Therefore arbitrary server-minted continuation fields are representable at the notification _meta model/type layer without a private transport extension. This is representation-only evidence and does not prove stock TaskStatusNotification runtime emission or durability.
